Title: New Azure API Management Visual Studio Code extension now available

Body.Content:
A new version of the Azure API Management Visual Studio Code extension was released on April 7, 2020. It includes these new features and improvements:

New

  • Import Azure App Service into API Management.
  • Import Azure Functions into API Management.
  • Integrate with the Extractor tool in our DevOps resource kit, which allows you to extract configurations of an API into a set of ARM templates.
  • Manage Gateway resources in the extension.

Changed

  • Updated output messages to be more user-friendly.
  • Improved user experience for long-running operations.

Learn more.
